items.question: Which event professionals do you work with?
items.answer: I work with all wedding event professionals: venues (estates, châteaux, mas, manors), caterers, photographers, videographers, florists, DJs, wedding planners and brands looking to professionalise their image, client acquisition and digital communication.

items.question: Organic growth or paid advertising — which to choose?
items.answer: Both are complementary. Organic (Instagram, TikTok, SEO) builds your brand and credibility long term. Paid (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) generates qualified leads quickly and lets you test angles. I build a hybrid acquisition strategy based on your digital maturity, your budget and your booking goals.

items.question: How much does a digital marketing agency specialised in events cost?
items.answer: My services start at €400 and are then on quote, because every event professional has specific needs (content volume, posting frequency, Meta / TikTok Ads budget, web project). I build à la carte support or a monthly retainer matched to your acquisition strategy.

items.question: How do you grow visibility as an event pro?
items.answer: Three complementary levers: cohesive, desirable visual content (Reels, photos), consistent social presence run by a community manager specialised in events, and paid campaigns targeted at your future clients. The Mariable editorial feature — included in every plan — amplifies it all with a highly qualified audience.

items.question: Why hand Meta Ads and TikTok Ads to a specialised agency?
items.answer: The events market has its own codes: strong seasonality, high purchase intent, multi-month decision journeys, look-alike audiences on engaged couples or event organisers. A generalist agency often burns budget without these specifics. I optimise your campaigns to generate qualified leads at the right cost.

items.question: Can you build the website for my business?
items.answer: Yes. I design custom showcase and booking websites for event pros: editorial design, SEO, contact forms, photo galleries, availability calendar integration. I also handle redesigns of existing websites.

items.question: What is a digital guide?
items.answer: A digital guide replaces the classic PDFs sent by email: welcome guide for signed clients, interactive brochure to showcase your commercial offer, practical booklet for your guests. More engaging, updated in real time and mobile-friendly.

items.question: Is the Mariable feature included in your services?
items.answer: Yes: the Mariable editorial feature is included by default in every plan. It gives you a dedicated editorial publication and visibility within my community of engaged couples.

items.question: Do you work everywhere in France?
items.answer: Yes, I support event pros across mainland France. Shoots and tapings happen on site; community management, paid acquisition and digital development are run remotely with regular check-ins.
